'''Fire Bolt''' is a [[Fire spells|fire]]-based [[Bolt spells|bolt spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 35 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

==Damage==
Fire Bolt has a base maximum hit of 12. Players who have completed the [[Family Crest]] quest can wear [[Chaos gauntlets]] to increase the maximum hit by an additional +3, up to 15.

As with all combat spells, Fire Bolt's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As a fire-based spell, Fire Bolt's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to fire]].

It should be noted that even with a fire rune-providing staff, [[tome of fire]] charges will still be consumed.
